What Green Card is

Good food is the point of the whole movement.

The Green Card Organic Food Ecosystem brings training, group farms, affordable organic food and a connected market together — so families can eat well and producers can find reliable buyers. With your Green Card you learn how to grow organic food, take part in organic group farming, enjoy the benefits from farm to table, and help build a trusted organic food market.

How it works

Four simple steps to begin

Your personal digital Green Card and membership number keep learning, farm slots, orders and your dashboard connected.

1

Get your Green Card

Sign up with ₦15,000 for registration, your first mushroom farm slot and the Mushroom Power starter pack. Extra farm slots are ₦5,000.

2

Get trained

Why members join

Health, training, farms and a trusted market

Organic food as medicine

Make organic food your medicine, so that medicine will not become your food. Good food is the point of the whole movement — chosen to help protect your family’s health.

Affordable food, healthier families

Members can enjoy organic food at a cheaper-than-market price, bringing healthier meals closer to home and helping families spend less on everyday food.

Practical organic farming training

Your training dashboard covers mushroom production, tomato and pepper farming, vegetable planting, composting, biochar, organic fertilisers and pesticides, plus chicken, fish and black soldier fly farming — all through practical, step-by-step video courses.

Group farms: three for one

Join Mushroom Village, Ginger Town and Organic Food Nation. Your group farm uses part of the income from its mushroom farm to develop the other two — three group farms for the price of one.

A trusted, verified marketplace

The marketplace helps buyers trust what they buy. Every listing shows the state, local government area and group-farm address, alongside product origin, price, stock and standards. Verified quality protects both the customer and the producer.

Green Points rewards

Participation earns Green Points and expands your access to organic food. Exchange points to reduce household food expenses. Organic waste taken to designated recycling centres can also increase your Green Points, and is turned into compost, organic fertilisers and farm feed.

The group farms

Mushroom Village, Ginger Town and Organic Food Nation

Fresh mushrooms and Mushroom Power are already being produced at the first Mushroom Village in Oyo State. Ginger Town group farms have also begun production there. Organic Food Nation widens your family’s choices through crops and livestock.

Mushroom Village

The first farm-to-table pathway. Fresh mushrooms and Mushroom Power start here. Groups of at least 50 Green Card holders can also request a free mushroom-spawn starter pack to launch a Mushroom Village unit in their locality.

Ginger Town

Ginger Town adds ginger production, with more opportunities to process and sell. Group farms have already kicked off production in Oyo State.

Organic Food Nation

Crops and livestock raised together, modelled as the first steps into a wider organic food offering for the family table and the marketplace.

Why mushrooms first

One crop, many uses

Mushrooms come first because one remarkable crop brings health, a practical first farm and many ways to sell. Fresh, dried or powdered, they can become several products for Nigerian families.

Mushroom Power, AgroHeal’s powdered mushroom, is a nutritional addition to every meal — and it is the content of the starter pack. Mushrooms are naturally low in calories, sodium and fat, and are a source of plant-based protein, B vitamins and the only non-animal source of dietary vitamin D.

From farm to table

A marketplace you can trust, and Green Points that grow with you

As the ecosystem expands, members can also become approved suppliers of verified products — including mushroom spawn, fresh or dried mushrooms, powder, organic vegetables, grains, roots, spices and fruit.

Your supplier dashboard follows each order through payment, delivery and any complaint or refund. Product commissions follow verified sales, and farm distributions follow actual income after costs.

Green Points add another layer: participate, redeem, shop and save. Organic waste is wealth — recycled into fresh compost, container-garden media, organic fertilisers and black soldier fly larvae (BSFL) protein feed for chicken and fish.

The vision

Healthy and wealthy Africans, starting from Nigeria

Our vision is to build Africa’s first and largest revolutionary organic food ecosystem, with the goal of raising millions of healthy and wealthy Africans before 2030, and with Nigeria as the springboard.

Too many families struggle to access nutritious food, while too few producers struggle to find reliable markets. Our answer is a connected food system in which training, group farms, product sales and local supply work together.

We grow food organically. We eat well. We build markets. We create wealth together.

Questions

A short guide to getting started

What is a Green Card, and what does ₦15,000 include?
Your complete start is ₦15,000: ₦2,000 for Green Card registration and access to the learning platform, ₦5,000 for your first mushroom farm slot, and ₦8,000 for your Mushroom Power starter pack and activation of your consumer network. Extra farm slots are ₦5,000 each.
What do I get once I have a Green Card?
Your personal digital Green Card and membership number keep everything connected: learning materials and LEAP community access, your affiliate link, farm slots, orders and your dashboard. The dashboard shows what you do, what you own and what you earn. One Green Card opens four pathways: learn, farm, consume and market.
Why do we start with mushrooms?
One crop brings health, a practical first farm and many ways to sell — fresh, dried or powdered. Mushroom Power, AgroHeal’s powdered mushroom, is also the content of the starter pack. Fresh mushrooms and Mushroom Power are presently being produced at the first Mushroom Village in Oyo State.
What are the three group farms?
Mushroom Village, Ginger Town and Organic Food Nation. Part of the income generated from the mushroom group farm is used to develop the other two — three for the price of one. Mushroom Village and Ginger Town production have already begun in Oyo State. Organic Food Nation widens family choices through crops and livestock.
How does the marketplace work?
The marketplace helps buyers trust what they buy. Every listing shows the state, local government area and group-farm address, alongside product origin, price, stock and standards. As the ecosystem expands, members can become approved suppliers of verified products. Verified quality protects both the customer and the producer.
What are Green Points?
Participation creates value, earns you Green Points and expands your access to organic food. You can exchange Green Points for organic food to reduce household food expenses. Organic waste taken to designated recycling centres is turned into farm inputs — and can increase your Green Points.
Are there ways to earn as a member?
Earning opportunities may include introducing and selling through referrals and retail, joining real group-farm production, and helping build customer volume. LEAP is cooperative farming and producer-consumer commerce, not passive investment. Product commissions follow verified sales, and farm distributions follow actual income after costs. Results depend on individual effort, participation and farm performance. This page does not promise income or returns.
